subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should `readRequestBodyWithLimit` permanently expose `destroyOnError` to external plugins, or should Copilot own response-before-teardown behavior without expanding the shared SDK API?
rationale: Both approaches can fix the bug, but choosing the permanent public plugin SDK teardown and cleanup contract requires maintainer intent rather than automated patch judgment.

options.title: Approve the additive SDK option
options.body: Keep the default-compatible option, document that false transfers cleanup ownership to the caller, and fix Copilot to wait for response completion before teardown.

options.title: Keep teardown owner-local
options.body: Leave the public helper unchanged and implement the bounded read plus response lifecycle entirely inside the Copilot plugin.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive SDK option
recommendation.body: Keep the default-compatible option, document that false transfers cleanup ownership to the caller, and fix Copilot to wait for response completion before teardown.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared bounded-body API and have recent involvement in adjacent Copilot runtime decisions.
